thread:
Asha (PM): Quick sync — we need a concrete, interruptible rollout plan for routing v2 + cost-fallbacks. FinServ customer asked for tenant opt-in + strict rollback guarantees. Can we sketch cohorts, metrics, and automated triggers?
Liam (Eng): +1. Proposal: staged regions by risk, and a 5-step canary ramp (1 -> 5 -> 20 -> 50 -> 100). Hold for 30m at 1%/5%, 2h at 20%, 4h at 50%.
Ravi (SRE): We should define automated rollback windows. Suggested triggers: p95 latency increase > 30% sustained for 5m OR error-rate > 0.2% for 2m OR model quality regression on smoke prompts. Also circuit-breaker per-AZ.
Elena (ProdOps): For tenant opt-in, add a flag namespace `feat.routing.v2` with per-tenant override. We'll expose a self-serve toggle for early adopters + a customer whitelist for FinServ.
Sara (QA): Need a pre-release test set (customer-specific prompts) run live in shadow for 48h. If synthetic eval drops > 1.5% top-level metric, block rollout. Also we'll run acceptance smoke after each ramp step.
Liam (Eng): For fallback behavior: prefer graceful degrade to quantized model variant (v2-8q) then to baseline routing v1. Sequence: routing.v2 -> v2-8q -> routing.v1. Routing policy should prefer cheaper model only if latency SLO at risk.
Asha (PM): Good. Include A/B test for quality vs cost for 20% cohort: 50/50 split between v2 full and v2-8q. We need to capture per-cohort quality metrics + cost delta.
Ravi (SRE): Observability: required dashboards: p50/p95/p99 latency, error-rate, tokens/sec, cost-per-1000-tokens, cache-hit-rate, and a "quality-regression" flag from the eval pipeline. Alert playbook if any threshold breached.
Elena (ProdOps): Flag naming and rollout metadata example:
```
{
  "flag": "feat.routing.v2",
  "default": false,
  "rollout": [ {"cohort":"canary","pct":1}, {"cohort":"stage-1","pct":5}, {"cohort":"stage-2","pct":20} ]
}
```
Liam (Eng): We should enforce a per-step kill switch: `routing.v2.kill` that immediately sends traffic back to routing.v1. Also make the fallback thresholds tunable per-tenant for FinServ.
Sara (QA): Test plan items: shadow traffic baseline collection (48h), synthetic regression harness, canary acceptance checklist (p95 < 1200ms, errors < 0.1%, quality delta < 1%). Documented sign-off required from Eng + SRE + Customer Success before 50% ramp.
Ravi (SRE): Automation: deploy-bot should annotate the rollout with current cohort percentages and watch windows. If automated trigger fires, deploy-bot executes the kill switch and opens an incident stub.
deploy-bot: [automation] Observability hooks integrated — will post roll progress and auto-trigger if configured thresholds breached.
Asha (PM): Launch criteria summary to include in the spec: (1) 48h shadow with no regressions, (2) canary 1/5/20 steps pass hold windows, (3) cost delta within expected bounds for the A/B cohort, (4) documented rollback playbook and automated kill switch tested.
Elena (ProdOps): Ops TODOs: create tenant whitelist, add per-tenant override page in Console, and author runbook for quick remap to routing.v1 + customer notification template.
Liam (Eng): Implementation TODOs: flag gating + rollout service integration, per-tenant thresholds, fallback router chain, and tests for kill switch race conditions.
Sara (QA): I'll schedule the shadow run once Eng signals readiness. Expect a short dry-run next Tue.
Asha (PM): OK — I'll consolidate this into the rollout section of the PRD and tag owners. Action items: Liam (eng) - infra + kill switch (due EOD Fri), Ravi - dashboards + alerts (due Mon), Elena - console + runbook (due Mon), Sara - shadow plan (due Tue). Anyone object?
Liam (Eng): fine with timelines.
Ravi (SRE): fine.
Elena (ProdOps): fine.
Sara (QA): no objections, will prep test harness.
Asha (PM): Great — I'll create the PRD update and link this thread. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
